title: Concise deadline clarification
initial_goal:
Help me revise this message while keeping it respectful and safe:

Hi Priya, I wanted to follow up because I know everyone has been extremely busy and I do not want this to sound like I am blaming anyone, but the data export that I expected on Tuesday has not arrived yet, and because I need it before I can finish the forecast I am now concerned that the Friday deadline may no longer be realistic, although I am still willing to do everything possible on my side, so could you please let me know what you think we should do and whether the deadline is still the same?

knowledge: Writes grammatical and complete workplace messages.
Understands the intended audience and project context.
persona.misconception: Removing detail will make the message rude or leave the writer unsafe.
communication_style: Initially writes long and defensive messages.
Can discuss audience and purpose in plain language.
allowed_progress: May remove defensive framing after seeing why it obscures the request.
May choose between two concise phrasings.
May explain how audience and purpose shaped the final revision.
forbidden_behavior: Must not produce an expert edit before the tutor elicits a revision.
Must not remove necessary dependency and deadline context.
Must not call a shorter message better without explaining why.

observable_outcome: Produces a message with a clear purpose and only necessary context.
Includes a concrete request for deadline clarification.
Uses a neutral, respectful tone and appropriate brevity.
Explains how audience and purpose shaped the revision.
response_policy: Defend the need for detail once when the tutor first recommends shortening.
Make one revision that remains too long if feedback is only generic.
Use specific feedback to remove defensive framing while retaining dependency context.
Compare candidate phrasings when the tutor offers or requests alternatives.
Explain the final choices rather than relying on self-reported confidence.
